claim: Flocons de Sel holds 3 Michelin stars; chef Emmanuel Renaut (Meilleur Ouvrier de France) creates Alpine gastronomy from lake fish, mushrooms, and mountain herbs
quote: Three Michelin stars (2025). Chef Emmanuel Renaut, a Meilleur Ouvrier de France, creates Alpine-inspired gourmet cuisine emphasizing emotion over technique.

claim: Flocons de Sel summer season runs June 5–November 1; phone +33 4 50 21 49 99; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays
quote: Operating Schedule (2026): June 5 - November 1. Closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

claim: Flocons de Sel rated 4.8/5 from 1,107 reviews; signature dishes include pike, Arctic char, wild mushrooms with Beaufort crust, and smoked chocolate dessert
quote: 4.8 of 5 bubbles (1,107 reviews) – Ranked #3 of 138 restaurants in Megève. Visitors praise pike preparations, wild mushrooms with Beaufort crust, Arctic char, venison with foie gras.

claim: Flocons de Sel tasting menu priced at approximately €310/person; wine pairing €115–160; offers 5- and 8-course options
quote: Tasting menu: €310 per person. Wine pairing: €115-160 per person. The restaurant offers either a la carte, or a five or eight course tasting menu.

claim: Flocons de Sel has nearly 1,200 wine references, an exceptional pre-1900 Chartreuse collection, Gault Millau 5 toques, and is a World's 50 Best Discovery
quote: Nearly 1,200 wines stocked, with emphasis on Savoie varietals. Notably houses an exceptional Chartreuse collection, including pre-1900 bottles. Featured in World's 50 Best Restaurants and Gault Millau (5 toques).

claim: La Table de l'Alpaga holds 1 Michelin star; located at 66 allée des marmousets, Megève; menus €190–225
quote: Michelin Stars: 1 star. Address: 66 allée des marmousets, Route de Prariand, 74120 Megève. Adult menus range from 190 to 225 euros.

claim: La Table de l'Alpaga: chef Alexandre Baule, vegetable-forward; 8-course €225, 6-course €190, vegetarian €160; winter-only Wed–Sun dinner 7:30–8:30 PM
quote: 1 Michelin Star. Chef: Alexandre Baule. 8-course tasting menu: €225. 6-course: €190. Vegetarian 6-course: €160. Open Wednesday-Sunday: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM. Closed during summer months.

claim: Vous is a 14-seat counter restaurant at 36 rue Saint-François, Megève; single sitting per meal; open Wed–Sun; minimum age 15
quote: 14 seats at gourmet counter with open kitchen view. Single sitting per meal. Off-season: Thursday-Sunday; Season: Wednesday-Sunday. Minimum age requirement: 15 years.

claim: Vous menu priced at €140–190/person; Gault Millau 14/20; signature dishes include cauliflower with iodized sauce and pike roe, wagyu chuck in Mondeuse jus
quote: Gault&Millau Rating: 14/20. Menu Price Range: €140–€190 per person. Offerings include cauliflower with iodized sauce and pike roe and wagyu chuck in Mondeuse jus.

claim: Vous received its first Michelin star in the 2025 Guide Michelin (announced March 31, 2025) with chefs Julien Gatillon and Jean Pastre
quote: Vous in Megève received its first Michelin star in the 2025 Guide Michelin, announced March 31, 2025. Chefs Julien Gatillon and Jean Pastre.

claim: La Dame de Pic–Le 1920 at Four Seasons Megève listed as permanently closed in the 2025 Michelin France update
quote: La Dame de Pic – Le 1920 (Megève, 74): marked as établissements définitivement fermés (permanently closed).

claim: La Dame de Pic–Le 1920 opened at Four Seasons Megève end of 2020 and was awarded its first Michelin star in the 2022 Guide
quote: At the end of 2020, she opened another restaurant called La Dame de Pic - Le 1920 at the Four Seasons Hotel in Megève, France. It was awarded its first Michelin star in the 2022 Guide.
